Fixture Lab releases Model B with open weights

Fixture Lab released Model B today with weights available under an open license, alongside a technical report describing the training setup and evaluation protocol in full detail.

Independent testing confirmed part of the claim: the model scores 20 percent higher on Benchmark B than its predecessor while cutting inference costs roughly in half for typical deployment sizes.

The release also includes a reference inference server, quantized checkpoints for smaller GPUs, and a model card documenting known limitations around multilingual performance and long-context reliability.

Builders can download the weights immediately, although the vendor-reported benchmark result should be treated as provisional until broader independent reproduction is available.
